LESSON: WRITING 13.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.5: Writing 13.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Composition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Composition, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use idioms in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.5.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Composition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and Problem Solving: A learner seeks advice to help solve the problem as peers review each other’s

work and revise as per the suggestions given

● Digital literacy: A learner uses digital devices with assistive technology to effectively accomplish their own tasks by

confirming the meaning of the idiomatic expressions from online dictionaries.

● Creativity and imagination: A learner undertakes to watch how people do things and write about it.

Values:
Integrity: A learner discuss and use the idiomatic expressions in writing.

Link to other subjects:

● Narrative writing is a skill in all languages.

● Performing Arts – Composing plays, poems, and narratives for performance require creative writing skills.

Suggested Learning Resources

Braille machine, braille paper, online/print dictionary, digital devices with assistive technology, sample compositions in

print and in braille.
